issue_context.title: Writing to `StreamWriter.Null` can cause exceptions

Fascinating. It's been like this forever, and I'm amazed we've never noticed before. A singleton exposed from a static should definitely not be implemented like this.
Yeah, it's not widely used nor useful. Especially with the existence of TextWriter.Null, which does the RightThing(tm) here.

I was lazily implementing some optional logging. When logging was disabled, I was concurrently sending lots of text to the null stream figuring doing this was somewhat wasteful but not actually harmful.

review_comments: Is it going to work fine for WASM?
I believe so, but it will just end up running it serially.
